title: Chapter 62 Crocodile Lizard
content:
Chapter 62 Crocodile Lizard

Seeing Wang Shuo kill the black bear cleanly, Duan Wenxi at the entrance of the village shouted: "The Lord is mighty!"

After someone took the lead, these drunken people also shouted: "The Lord is mighty!"

"The Lord is invincible!"

...

The blood of the people was boiling!

Wang Shuo checked and found that the loyalty had increased by 3 points on average.

He nodded with satisfaction and smiled knowingly.

Back to the campfire, Wang Shuo ordered people to drag the black bear back, and asked Zhou Keyu to deal with the black bear and give it to everyone as a midnight snack!

At night, Wang Shuo returned to the bedroom. The joy of killing the black bear had disappeared, replaced by deep worry.

The speed at which the beasts outside were leveling up was faster than Wang Shuo expected.

It may not take long for the beasts to attack the village.

It seems that we must set off as soon as possible to Nanshanji, otherwise the variables will increase.

…

In the early morning, Wang Shuo looked at the people in the meeting hall and said, "I decided to go to the nearest Nanshan Market today to check the situation. It is not okay to stay here all the time and be completely ignorant of the changes in the outside world."

"I will definitely return in one day at the shortest and three to five days at the most."

"Matar, is the flaming gun you made ready?"

Matar walked into the hall and said proudly, "My Lord, it has been made. Please take a look."

As he said that, he took out a fiery red spear from his backpack and handed it to Wang Shuo.

He took the flaming spear and felt it was very heavy.

He looked down and saw that the gun body was dark red, about 2 meters long, and engraved with flame patterns, which was very gorgeous.

[Flame Gun: Gold quality, Strength +30, Attack +100, with burning effect, Skill: Flame Breath: Charge for 2 seconds, release a flame, causing 300 points of fire damage to the target, CD: 10 minutes, durability 100/100. ]

Wang Shuo was delighted after seeing it. This attribute is simply amazing, and it also has a burning effect. Every hit will have continuous damage.

Although Wang Shuo likes it very much, he knows that the most suitable person for this gun at this moment is Ayub, and only he can maximize the power of the Flame Gun.

"Abu, this gun will be handed over to you!" Wang Shuo laughed heartily.

Although he was a little reluctant, he did not show it and threw the Flame Gun to Ayub.

After Ayub got the Flame Gun, he waved it a few times and said to Wang Shuo in a deep voice: "Lord, although this gun is very good, it is not suitable for me. I am more used to using a long-handled broadsword."

"Oh?" Wang Shuo was surprised and had to put away the Flame Gun.

Then he made arrangements for Duan Wenxi and others.

"Suo Yong, in the next few days, you have to build 10 arrow towers and 10 energy towers inside the outer wall to strengthen the defense of the territory and be prepared to deal with attacks by wild beasts."

"Yes, Lord."

"At the same time, build more houses. The population of our territory will definitely increase in the future, so we can prepare in advance."

"Yes, Lord."

"Matar, you must do your best to make excellent equipment, and also make more arrows to ensure the supply of arrow towers."

...

"I'll leave the affairs of the village to you!"

"Yes, Lord."

Wang Shuo explained everything he thought of one by one, and after leaving enough resources, he took his cavalry team and embarked on the journey to Nanshanji.

Da Huang also followed the cavalry and kept chasing. Wang Shuo thought about it and did not drive it back.

It has been a while since Da Huang was taken in. In the past few days, it has eaten well and grown a circle, but it still can't keep up with the speed of the warhorse. Wang Shuo let Gong Zheng hold it in his arms and hurry on.

Wana Village is about 50 miles away from Nanshan Market. According to their horse riding speed, they can return in less than a day. Considering the unexpected situations that may occur on the road, Wang Shuo estimated that it would take 2 days.

Before officially going to Nanshan Market, Wang Shuo explored the area around Wana Village within 15 miles.

Wang Shuo found a large number of villages, but he did not alarm the enemy.

At the same time, he also found several hidden dangers.

In particular, there was a group of bandits hiding on Watang Mountain.

After Wang Shuo captured a bandit alive, he inquired about the situation of some bandits.

This gave him some bad premonitions.

Moreover, a wolf pack was found in the direction of the grassland in the south.

At present, these two dangers are not serious. As long as the arrow tower is built, Wana Village can easily deal with them.

But Wang Shuo couldn't do it immediately.

First, it takes a lot of time, and second, he will definitely be seriously injured.

Wang Shuo gave up the idea of immediately destroying it, and took everyone to continue to the southeast direction of Nanshan Market.

Along the way, Wang Shuo encountered many low-level beasts, but they were unable to pose any obstacle under the iron hoofs of the cavalry and were quickly killed.

On a high hill, Wang Shuo ordered everyone to take a rest.

Gong Zheng took out the dry food prepared in advance and replenished everyone's physical strength.

Wang Shuo had previously seized a large number of intermediate backpacks, so everyone could carry a large amount of supplies.

At this time, Baili Liang came over and suggested to Wang Shuo: "Lord, we have killed a lot of wild animals along the way, and many of them have delicious meat. Why don't we roast some and try them!"

Wang Shuo stood up and looked around. He found that there was no danger, so he agreed to his proposal.

After lighting a fire, Wang Shuo sat by the fire and drank a sip of water. He was still a little worried, so he sent the three brothers Gong Zheng to patrol and guard the surrounding area.

Baili Liang put an elk on the fire and roasted it until it was three-tenths cooked, and Gong Zheng returned.

He panted a little and said: "Lord, we found a silver treasure chest in the grove to the north, but it is surrounded by a group of big lizards."

Wang Shuo stood up with a smile on his face and asked anxiously: "Did you see it clearly, it's a silver treasure chest?"

He opened a resurrection coin from the previous silver treasure chest, which shows that the value of the silver treasure chest is very high, and it is easy to open important props.

As for the big lizard, he selectively ignored it.

With Ayub here, as long as there is no combat power at the level of a general, there will be no problem.

"Let's go and pick up the treasure chest!" Wang Shuo directly summoned the warhorse and rushed over first.

At this time, Baili Liang was still thinking about his barbecue.

At this time, Guliji walked over, kicked him, and laughed and scolded: "Go quickly, otherwise, the lord will send you to lead the charge later, let's see what you can do!"

"I'm just a small follower, there is no need for me to go out, Ayub can handle it alone!" Baili Liang muttered in a low voice, but he immediately summoned the warhorse and followed.

Not long after, Wang Shuo passed through a small forest and came to a pool.

Not far from the pool, there is a waterfall, and there are a large number of lizards under and around the waterfall.

"Lord, the treasure chest is in the cave under the waterfall!" Gong Kai replied.

"It's so hidden, how did you find it?" Wang Shuo certainly didn't doubt what Gong Kai said, but it was still a little incredible.

"My Lord, these lizards didn't appear just now. They suddenly emerged from the pool when I stepped into the cave."

"So that's how it is!"

Wang Shuo looked thoughtfully and glanced at these lizards. Their levels were generally between level 8 and level 15.

The largest one was a bronze boss.

[Crocodile Lizard (ID: Crocodile xxxxx Laxi, bronze boss)]

[Level: Level 15]

[Attack Power: 160]

[Defense Power: 50]

[HP: 6000]

[Skill: Paralysis Attack. ]
